user_stories.title: Implement complexity estimation heuristics
acceptance_criteria: estimate_complexity(instruction, tools, context_length) returns float in [0.0, 1.0]
Instruction length contributes up to 0.3 to score (normalized to 500 chars)
Complexity keywords contribute up to 0.3 to score
COMPLEXITY_KEYWORDS dict maps keywords to weights (analyze=0.3, optimize=0.4, etc.)
Tool complexity contributes up to 0.3 to score
COMPLEX_TOOLS dict maps tool names to complexity (code_execute=0.3, web_search=0.2, etc.)
Context size contributes up to 0.1 to score (normalized to 2000 chars)
Score is capped at 1.0 (min(score, 1.0))
Empty instruction returns score 0.0
No tools and empty context work correctly
Keyword matching is case-insensitive
user_stories.notes: Simple heuristics for complexity estimation. No NLP needed, good enough for cost-aware routing.
